可用端点（全部 HTTP 200，已实测）：
- seasons 列表：`https://stats-api.mlssoccer.com/competitions/MLS-COM-000001/seasons`（赛季标识权威源）
- 赛季球队：`.../clubs/competitions/MLS-COM-000001/seasons/{season_id}?per_page=100`
- 逐场：`.../matches/seasons/{season_id}?competition_id=MLS-COM-000001&match_date=YYYY-MM-DD&per_page=1000`（match_date 必填；字段：match_id, match_day, match_day_id, match_type=MATCHWEEK n, competition_label='MLS Regular Season YYYY', competition_name='Major League Soccer - Regular Season', home/away team_id+name, planned_kickoff_time, match_status, result, stadium）
- 积分榜：`.../competitions/MLS-COM-000001/seasons/{season_id}/standings`（position, club_id, games_played, W/D/L, points, points_per_game）
- 官方列表端点无一为空、无 blocked；无需保留 unavailable。

3. `lineage/historical-name-api-gap` — 官方 API 名称回填问题已如实记录，更名链用媒体源。
4. `lineage/no-relocations-mergers-2018-2025` — 确认为负，无迁移/解散/合并。
5. `matches/2020-postponed-canceled` — 2020 延期场次未动、未重抓 ESPN 2018–2020 结果（按指令）。
